title: Conditional κ = 0.00359528269 (+0.453% over #6918): helper splits on top of flips and sinks
body:
**Claim.** Conditional κ = 0.00359528269, tested price 0.0035952826907 (raw crossing 0.0035952826938257874), **+0.453% over #6918**, the highest open claim. Package `research/p104-split-shared-native`. Root, caller and port mix are #6917's. S = 1520; the gain is all in the denominator.

**Credit.** The helper-split lemma is Ali Romman's (#5599), and its application to the shared native word is CubeJerry's (#6916). The splits in this word come from our own code; the sharing moves and sinks are from #6917 and this package.

**What changes against #6917.** 69 helper splits, 11 extra paid stops (a hop that skips a frame gets a stop there, S-neutral, at a cost below the split it unlocks), and 16 sinks. Each helper has exactly one productive credit, frames are strictly nested, and mains are excluded. The T and P differences match the split and stop lists exactly. "Sinks" describes the plan: ADD lists are rebuilt, and correctness rests only on the exact replay plus the physical and caller replays. Controls reject a wrong split coefficient, an aliased piece and a wrong sink.

**Conditional on** #6917's assumptions and departures: the five of #6833, A6 owned ascent (23 rises, mass 56, peak 30), the BIT admission of open #6726 (margin 1.714e-4), and the per-port root.

**Scope and caveats.**
- Logarithm power 2207 written (minimum 2206, carrier m = 153).
- Raw 962,308,192 / 974,344,504 / 989,401,288 (below 10^9). With the LAMBDA debit of #6913 at this mix (12.56M) the conservative total is 1,001,961,288, 0.196% over 10^9. No outer-ledger term reads that number; declared as a parameter excess.
- Coefficients grew: two ADDs have |q| = 9027/2. 74,565 events.
- Algebraic all-columns checks pass, using the method of #6890 (CubeJerry). No adjoint replay and no streams at width >= 2 were run. The BIT verifiers and Theorem 1G were not re-derived here.

**How to verify.** `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-split-shared-native` prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
